title.zh: v2.1.9 CI 的 Node 版本：jsdom 30 需要 Node 22，而 CI 跑在 Node 20
title.en: v2.1.9 CI's Node Version: jsdom 30 Needs Node 22, and CI Ran on Node 20

highlights.zh: **CI 红不是代码错。** `npm run test:coverage` 报 190 条 `webidl.util.markAsUncloneable is not a function`，**一个测试都没跑**，覆盖率 0% 撞阈值——于是 CI 只留下「覆盖率不达标」这句话，和真实原因毫无关系。原因是 **CI 用 Node 20 跑只有 Node 22 才能跑的 jsdom 30**：它内置的 `undici` 8 在 `cachestorage.js` 里调用 `worker_threads.markAsUncloneable`，这个导出 Node 20 没有。所以 `rm -rf node_modules` 重装解决不了——同样的依赖会在同样的旧 Node 上再装出来。
highlights.en: **The red CI was not a code failure.** `npm run test:coverage` reported 190 `webidl.util.markAsUncloneable is not a function` errors with **no test executed** and 0 % coverage, so the only visible message was a coverage-threshold failure that had nothing to do with the cause. CI ran **Node 20** for `jsdom` 30, which needs Node 22: the `undici` 8 it vendors calls `worker_threads.markAsUncloneable` in `cachestorage.js`, and Node 20 does not export it. highlights.zh: **证据**：`jsdom@30.0.1` 的 `engines.node` 是 `^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0`；它内置的 `undici@8.10.2` 要求 `>=22.19.0`；`cachestorage.js:20` 正是那一句调用；而 `typeof worker_threads.markAsUncloneable` 在 Node 22.22.3 上是 `function`、在 Node 20 上是 `undefined`。本地 Node 22.22.3 上 `npm run test:coverage` **exit 0**：192 文件 / 2185 用例，覆盖率 lines 90.58% / branches 75.31% / functions 66.08%（阈值 78 / 60 / 58）——**阈值没问题，问题只在环境**。
highlights.en: **The evidence**: `jsdom@30.0.1` declares `engines.node: ^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0`; the `undici@8.10.2` it vendors requires `>=22.19.0`; `cachestorage.js:20` is exactly that call; and `typeof worker_threads.markAsUncloneable` is `function` on Node 22.22.3 and `undefined` on Node 20. highlights.zh: **修法**：两个 CI job 都改为 `node-version-file: ".nvmrc"`，`.nvmrc` = `22.22.2`（正是 jsdom 声明的**下限**，所以 CI 跑「最低支持版本」，谁把要求悄悄抬高都会先红）；`package.json` 加 `engines.node`；`.npmrc` 开 `engine-strict`，不支持的 Node 在**安装阶段**就报 `EBADENGINE`（实测：`engines` 临时改成 `>=99` 时 `npm install --engine-strict` 立即失败）；新增 `npm run check:node` 作为 verify 第一步——它不自己实现 semver 范围判断，而是**直接构造一个 JSDOM**，环境能不能跑问它本人，顺带覆盖「在别的 Node 上装好的 node_modules 拿来跑」这种情况。README（中英）的「Node 20 或更新」改成「22.22.2 或更新」并写明原因。
highlights.en: **The fix**: both CI jobs now use `node-version-file: ".nvmrc"` with `.nvmrc` = `22.22.2` — exactly the floor jsdom declares, so CI runs the *minimum* supported version and anyone quietly raising the requirement goes red first; `package.json` gains `engines.node`; `.npmrc` sets `engine-strict`, so an unsupported Node fails at **install** time with `EBADENGINE` (verified: with `engines` temporarily set to `>=99`, `npm install --engine-strict` fails immediately); and `npm run…
